newsitem.title: UK: Barings' New Russia Fund raises $35.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Barings' New Russia Fund raises $35.3 mln.

text.p: Baring Brothers said on Monday the New Russia Fund had raised $35.3 million through a placing of shares.

It said 3.53 million shares had been placed in the fund, which seeks long term growth, primarily in companies operating in Russia, and to a lesser extent the Ukraine and the other former Soviet republics.
Investment will be made principally in traded equity and equity-related securities.

The investment manager is Baring Mutual Fund Management, part of the Baring Asset Management (BAM) group. BAM managed total assets in excess of $40 billion, including $4.7 billion in emerging markets, at the end of 1996.
Of this, over $300 million was in the former Soviet Union.
Following the placing, ING Investment Management will hold 1.25 million shares in the fund. Dealing in the shares is expected to start in Luxembourg on March 24.
